h: So, what’s it like to be part of the Communitech team?
subpages.text: Skip to content Events Programs Membership About Us Our Story Our Team Careers FR/EN Show Site menu Close Site menu FR/EN Events Programs Insights In the ecosystem Resources Tech News Archives About Us Our Story Our Team Meet Our Experts Careers Join the Community Connect with us Working at Communitech So, what’s it like to be part of the Communitech team? As a team, our focus is great customer service and helping tech-driven companies overcome barriers to success. We stand behind our mission of 25+ years and execute it with passion, persistence and care. It's pulling together We work hard and we work together. We work to solve problems as a collective that companies face individually. We aren’t afraid to roll up our sleeves and tackle the tough stuff; and we do it free of ego, all pulling together toward our mission. It's personal well-being We’re given the tools to lead healthy and balanced lives. From competitive benefits and insurance coverage, fitness allowance and professional development funds, our hard work is balanced with a high regard for workplace happiness and personal wellbeing. It's fair, flexible compensation We have incredible benefits with no wait period. Already have benefits? Invest the spend into your RRSP! On top of respected, paid vacation we also enjoy a paid holiday shutdown. Access to an education spend allows you to choose your path of development. It's building a network As a Communitecher, you are in the heart of one of the most dynamic ecosystems anywhere. With access to events, peer groups, and training programs, you can build a great network both within our walls and beyond. subpages.title: Our Story - Communitech
h: COMMUNITECH Waterloo Region’s tech community since 1997.
Helping companies put AI to work in Waterloo Region
subpages.text: Skip to content Events Programs Membership About Us Our Story Our Team Careers FR/EN Show Site menu Close Site menu FR/EN Events Programs Insights In the ecosystem Resources Tech News Archives About Us Our Story Our Team Meet Our Experts Careers Join the Community Connect with us COMMUNITECH Waterloo Region’s tech community since 1997. Helping Waterloo Region tech companies start, scale and stay here. 1164 Members (as of FY26) 104 Events hosted (as of FY26) $400,782,429 CAD Capital raised (as of FY26) 23 Peer Groups (as of FY26) 28 Years in business 916 AI Adoption Hours (as of FY26) Who we are Communitech is a membership organization shaped by the people building tech companies in Waterloo Region. Since 1997, we've brought founders, leaders and teams together to help more companies start here, scale here and stay here. We're working toward a stronger Waterloo Region tech community, one with more founders, more growing companies and more reasons for talented people to build their careers here. A place where companies choose to stay and others choose to put down roots. Today, more than 1,100 companies are part of the Communitech network. What we do We bring Waterloo Region tech together. Through programs, events and membership, founders, leaders and the people working across local tech companies come together to learn from one another, share what’s working and build relationships that help them move forward. Whether you’re growing a company, leading a team, exploring AI, protecting intellectual property or looking to expand your network, chances are someone in this network has been there before. That’s what makes Communitech different. It’s not one company, one founder or one perspective. It’s a network of more than 1,100 companies learning, sharing and building together

subpages.text: Skip to content Events Programs Membership About Us Our Story Our Team Careers FR/EN Show Site menu Close Site menu FR/EN Events Programs Insights In the ecosystem Resources Tech News Archives About Us Our Story Our Team Meet Our Experts Careers Join the Community Connect with us Accessibility policy Statement of Commitment Communitech is committed to providing equal access and participation for all individuals including its customers, employees, visitors, tradespersons, job applicants and any other person(s) who may enter its premises or use its services. As an organization, we respect and uphold the requirements set forth under the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (2005), and its associated standards and regulations. We understand that we have a responsibility for ensuring a safe, dignified, and welcoming environment for all individuals. We are committed to ensuring our organization's compliance by incorporating accessibility legislation into our policies, procedures, programming, events, training, facilities and best practices. We will review these policies and practices annually, as organizational changes occur, or in anticipation of compliance deadlines. In addition, we will strive to meet the needs of individuals with disabilities in a timely and effective manner in a way that maintains their dignity and independence. Providing an accessible and barrier-free environment is a shared effort, and as an organization, Communitech is committed to working with the necessary parties to make accessibility a reality. For more detailed information on our accessibility policies, plans, and training programs, please contact: info@communitech.ca .
